item.content:encoded:
Act as if every SCP will be the first that someone will read.

While not the first tale I have read, this absolutely qualifies as the first that made me more interested in extra-Foundation activities. There is a vast majority of this site I'd never bothered to explore further prior to reading this, and now I find myself far more interested in the non-SCP "cannon" than I have been in my 5+ years of casually browsing the wiki.

Fantastically done. +1.
